thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: ReservedCapacityAlert for tenant 'emberlane' fired on dedicated-pool ember-pool-2. Rule: reserved-pool-latency-high. p95 latency > 1.2s, 503 rate 8% over 5m. link: https://console.redwood/alerts/RC-4087654321

Maria Gomez: Acked. I'm on call. seeing surge in queue depth on ember-pool-2, CPU pinned on infer nodes, backlog growing. Impact: customer API errors and elevated tail latency.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Maria Gomez (oncall). Escalation will wait 5m before auto-escalate.

Maria Gomez: Quick triage:
- Metric snapshots (5m window): p95=1.35s, p99=2.9s, 503_count=125 (8.2%).
- Pool: ember-pool-2 (reserved for tenant emberlane) - 8 infer nodes (A100).
- Symptom: steady request queue + occasional soft OOM evictions on gpu-3.
- Probable cause: sudden tenant traffic surge + imperfect autoscale config for reserved pool.

Lee Chen: @Maria any signs of model-level KV-cache thrash or very long sequences?

Maria Gomez: Not yet, sequence lengths normal. KV hit rate ~92%. CPU/IO looks ok, GPU mem pressure and queueing on the serving side.

Maria Gomez: Mitigation plan (short): 1) temporarily route a portion of emberlane traffic to shared fallback pool (shared-pool-1) 2) add 2 nodes to ember-pool-2 3) enable emergency backpressure throttling (soft limit) 4) notify CSM + customer.

AJ Patel: On my way in, will take lead if we need infra changes. Maria pls start step 1 (routing) now if you can.

Maria Gomez: Doing step 1 now. Pushing routing change to policy:
```
# rollout: route 25% of tenant emberlane to shared-pool-1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/routing/tenants/emberlane/override \
  -d '{"percent_shared":25, "reason":"emergency spillover"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN'
```

Maria Gomez: routing change applied. Confirming traffic split in metrics...

ops-bot: config-change: routing override for tenant 'emberlane' created by Maria Gomez. ID rc-emer-001.

Maria Gomez: Starting step 2: scaling pool. Running k8s scale (temporary).
```
kubectl --context=prod-asia scale statefulset/ember-pool-2 --replicas=10 -n redwood-serving
```

Maria Gomez: Nodes provisioning, currently 2/2 additional nodes coming up.

incident-bot: Alert: ember-pool-2 node sic-03 reported soft-oom during model load at 4087654450.

Lee Chen: Can we drop to a smaller model shard or switch to a 4-bit quant variant for this tenant while we stabilize? Shouldn't change output semantics too much.

Maria Gomez: Good idea. I'll flip model variant to emberbase-quant4 as a degraded fallback for new requests. Doing toggle now.

Maria Gomez: Model toggle cmd:
```
redwood ctl tenant-config set emberlane --model-fallback emberbase-quant4 --ttl 15m
```

Maria Gomez: Toggle applied. New sessions should pick fallback variant.

csm_lucy: FYI I'm pinging the Emberlane CSM and their support channel. Leaving a short note: "we're seeing increased latency and errors on your reserved pool; we've routed 25% to shared capacity and are scaling the pool. Will update in 10m."

AJ Patel: I see p95 drop from 1.35s -> 0.9s after routing + model-fallback. 503 rate down to 3.1%. Nice. Keep scaling to healthy node count and watch for evictions.

Maria Gomez: New nodes ready, ember-pool-2 at 10 nodes. GPU mem pressure lowered. p99 trending down.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation cancelled; incident under active mitigation.

Maria Gomez: Running a few health checks:
```
# sanity check against emberlane health endpoint
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN' https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/emberlane/health | jq '.'
# sample result: {"status":"degraded","active_nodes":10,"queue_depth":14}
```

Lee Chen: Any sign of degraded quality from emberbase-quant4? Did customer notice?

Maria Gomez: Quick sample evals look acceptable for 90% of flows. We'll keep quality monitoring on and revert fallback after things stable.

AJ Patel: I'll stay on for next 20m to confirm stabilization, then hand back. Maria set an incident note and link to logs: https://logs.redwood/emberlane/4087654321

Maria Gomez: Note added to incident. Also adding temporary alert suppression to avoid spam: suppress reserved-pool-latency rule for ember-pool-2 for 30m.

ops-bot: suppression: rule reserved-pool-latency suppressed for ember-pool-2 by Maria Gomez until +1800s.

csm_lucy: Customer update posted. They're OK with routing to shared pool for now, asked for ETA on full restore — I gave ~30-45m.

AJ Patel: p95 stable around 0.85-0.95s, 503 <1.5%. Queue depth back to baseline. I'm going to mark mitigation successful in 15m if numbers hold.

Maria Gomez: Oncall handoff: I'll keep this thread pinned. If anything regresses ping @aj directly. Adding follow-up action items:
- postmortem owning: SRE (Maria) + Eng-Platform (Lee)
- review autoscale config for reserved pools + burst policies
- add automated graceful fallback routing for reserved pools

Maria Gomez: Final note for the thread: root cause likely traffic surge + autoscale latency + a transient soft-oom on one node. Mitigations: spill to shared pool, scale nodes, model fallback. No customer data incident.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident resolved (manual) by Maria Gomez.

Maria Gomez: Closing here. Moving to #postmortems/emberlane and will schedule a 1hr blameless review tomorrow. :white_check_mark: :eyes:
